<!-- House PR format — full rules in studio/PR-WORKFLOW.md.
     One PR = ONE decision. Title: [book][TYPE] <what merging decides>
     Types: PREMISE OUTLINE CANON RULE DECISION AUTHOR-INPUT ADOPTION
            SERIES RELEASE AGENTS MINOR (MINOR = rule-7 auto-merge lane)
     Merge = approved = recorded. Comments are rulings. Agents never
     merge non-MINOR PRs. -->

Type: <TYPE>          Blocked work: <what waits on this>

Ask: <one sentence — what does merging decide?>

Passage:
> <the actual book/doc lines this decision touches — the author
> decides from the body alone; quote the BOOK, not just rule text>

Context: <max 3 lines>

Options:
- **A (recommended — applied in this diff):** <one line>
- B: <one line>

Deadline pressure: <none | date + why>
